subject: Auditing and Ethics
question_text:
13. ABC Ltd. is undergoing an audit, and the auditors are evaluating the
reliability of different types of audit evidence. External evidence is generally
considered to be more reliable than internal evidence.

The following is NOT an example of internal evidence:
(A)  Inspection report
(B)  Purchase invoice
(C)  Goods received note
(D)  Bank reconciliation statement
(2 Marks)
